latest_release.name: v0.170.0
latest_release.body: The big change in this release is that **the _extended_ edition of Hugo is gone**. LibSass has been deprecated for a long time, and it was the main reason we needed a CGO-enabled extended build. There is now only one Hugo binary, and apart from LibSass it has all the features the extended build had. ## Notes * Setting `transpiler` to `libsass` in [`css.Sass`](https://gohugo.io/functions/css/sass/) now returns an error. [Dart Sass](https://gohugo.io/functions/css/sass/#dart-sass) is now the default and the only transpiler, so you need to [install it](https://gohugo.io/functions/css/sass/#installation-overview) if you use Sass. * We no longer publish `hugo_extended_*` archives. To avoid breaking existing CI setups, we publish aliases for the most downloaded extended archives (e.g. `hugo_extended__linux-amd64.tar.gz`, `hugo_extended__Linux-64bit.tar.gz`, the `linux-amd64.deb`, `linux-arm64.tar.gz` and `windows-amd64.zip`), but you should update your scripts to use the standard archives. The `extended_withdeploy` builds are also removed. See [Installation](https://gohugo.io/installation/). * [`hugo.IsExtended`](https://gohugo.io/functions/hugo/isextended/) now always returns `false`, and the module config setting `hugoVersion.extended` is deprecated and has no effect. * Command-line flags (e.g. `--buildDrafts`) now override OS [environment variables](https://gohugo.io/configuration/introduction/#environment-variables) (e.g. `HUGO_BUILDDRAFTS`). This also fixes `HUGO_ENVIRONMENT=qa hugo build -e staging` loading the `staging` config but reporting `qa` in `hugo.Environment`. * [`strings.Truncate`](https://gohugo.io/functions/strings/truncate/) has been rewritten on top of a proper HTML scanner. It now handles comments, void elements, quoted attributes with `>` and raw text elements such as `script` correctly, and it's faster and allocates less. On a curious note, the old version was implemented by [Mathias Biilmann](https://github.com/biilmann), the Netlify CEO. * `time.Time` values now keep their named time zone, and [`eq`](https://gohugo.io/functions/compare/eq/), `ne`, `in` and `uniq` compare `time.Time` values by instant. * [`resources.Match`](https://gohugo.io/functions/resources/match/) and friends now preserve the directory casing in the matched paths, so e.g. `resources.Match "gallery/Travel/Iceland/*"` now works on case-sensitive file systems. * Syncing of static files is much faster for big unchanged files, as we now skip the content check for files with the same size and modification time. * Several fixes and hardening of the WASM based image codecs (AVIF crash at `encoderSpeed` 6 and lower, recovering from broken WASM instances in the server). ## Security ### Hugo * [Passthrough](https://gohugo.io/configuration/markup/#passthrough) content is now HTML escaped when no passthrough render hook is set, unless `markup.goldmark.renderer.unsafe` is enabled. Before this, e.g. `\(\)` in a content file emitted raw HTML. * The `wrapperClass` option, settable from the [`highlight`](https://gohugo.io/shortcodes/highlight/) shortcode and [`transform.Highlight`](https://gohugo.io/functions/transform/highlight/), is now escaped. * [Vendored](https://gohugo.io/hugo-modules/use-modules/#vendor) module paths are now restricted to the `_vendor` directory (symlinks pointing outside are rejected). Thanks to @R0X4R for finding and reporting the last two issues. ### Go This release is built with Go 1.27.4, which [includes 12 security fixes](https://groups.google.com/g/golang-announce/c/iY8TY0wWgbM/m/KsU1KfWgAQAJ). The one most relevant for Hugo is a crash in the `net/http` HTTP/1 server (used by `hugo server`) caused by a race in `MaxBytesReader`. The other 11 are in the `cmd/go` toolchain (cgo flag and linker injection at build time) and mainly matter if you build Hugo from source with untrusted dependencies. ### Dependencies * `golang.org/x/net` v0.62.0 [fix
